the_batch_s_own_recommendation_was_rejec.what: TASK-20260802-15971b recommended sequencing A19 first. DEC-20260802-9664c6 D-3 REJECTS it.
the_batch_s_own_recommendation_was_rejec.why: A19's 10.61/7.96/16.79 bits is arithmetically CORRECT and was independently verified against RMRS's published Table 4. But Theorem 6.1 with Prop 6.1.3's p_i misses SPEC Table 5's own targets at all three levels while 6.1.4 clears, Table 11's values are numerically 6.1.4's, and the spec's Changelog records the improved bound as what set the parameters. A19 is a STALE CROSS-REFERENCE worth ZERO published bits.
the_batch_s_own_recommendation_was_rejec.the_process_point: Verifying the numbers was NECESSARY AND NOT SUFFICIENT. The validator declined to recompute them and flagged A19 as only partly confirmed; the red team recomputed them, found them right, and defeated the recommendation on what they MEAN. A retarget accepted on arithmetic alone would have redirected this campaign onto a typographical inconsistency.

retracted_claims: 'The 49 is the transcription's own error' - FALSE; it is printed in the published specification.
'This batch's opening commit message blamed the transcription' - it did not; the Coordinator overstated the extent of its own error while correcting it.

'RETARGETING AWAY from A17' - a MISREADING OF THE COORDINATOR'S OWN PRODUCER, which recommended retargeting A17 to mu_{delta_e+1} WITHIN the same lane and sequencing A19 second. The primary recommendation was dropped in transmission and is recovered as this goal's next action.
'A19 exceeds the conservatism budget' - an incommensurable comparison forwarded uncritically.
